error_reason: The agent incorrectly included Kirstjen Nielsen in the dataset of Secretaries of Homeland Security, failing to apply the specific constraint 'excluding those who held the position in an acting capacity.' Since Nielsen is an acting official, her exclusion from the list was required to identify the correct easternmost university (UMass Boston in Boston); her inclusion shifted the easternmost candidate to Cambridge (Harvard/MIT/GovU context), leading to the final incorrect answer. Had the filtering logic correctly excluded her at this step, the error chain would have been broken.

hypotheses.rationale: This step is the decisive error because the agent included Kirstjen Nielsen in the list of secretaries. Nielsen held the position only in an acting capacity prior to April 2019, so her university (Georgetown) should have been excluded per the task requirements. Including her removed UMass Boston (the easternmost of the valid set), leading the agent to incorrectly identify Cambridge as the easternmost city.
